content.rendered:
The Fun Run is not only something students look forward to each year, but it’s also Archer Glen’s largest fundraiser! The Fun Run is scheduled for Friday, September 27. During the Fun Run, students will run around the outdoor Archer Glen track. Parents/Guardians are welcome to watch and cheer on the students during their run!

Each student is encouraged to collect monetary donations to support Archer Glen from family, friends, and neighbors. We collect donations over a two-week period from 9/13/24-9/27/24 (the day of the Fun Run).
